01 / About

I build by understanding the system first, then making the experience simpler.

My academic work is centered on computer science fundamentals: programming, object-oriented design, data structures, logic, problem solving and software architecture.

Alongside that foundation, I am growing into web development, databases and cloud technologies so I can build complete applications instead of isolated pieces of code.
